title: Fujita freeness for projectivized toric vector bundles
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective toric variety of dimension $n\geq1$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, let $\mathcal E$ be a toric vector bundle of rank $r\geq2$, and let $π\colon Y=\mathbb P_X(\mathcal E)\to X$ be the projective bundle of one-dimensional quotients. Write an ample line bundle on $Y$ as $A=\mathcal O_Y(a)\otimesπ^*L$, with $a\geq1$.
